artist.name: Maisie Peters
artist.short_description: Maisie Peters is an Afterglow discovery artist in the broader emotional-pop and songwriter catalogue.
artist.biography: Maisie Peters is an English singer-songwriter whose catalogue blends diaristic relationship writing with big pop hooks and sharply observed characters. After sharing original songs online as a teenager, she released the EPs Dressed Too Nice for a Jacket and It's Your Bed Babe, It's Your Funeral. Her debut album You Signed Up for This came out in 2021. She then expanded her storytelling on The Good Witch, released in 2023, with songs including 'Body Better,' 'Lost The Breakup,' 'History Of Man' and 'There It Goes.' Florescence arrived in 2026, adding further material to the catalogue. Peters has discussed how heartbreak, humour and self-scrutiny can coexist in her songwriting, while live performances can gradually change what a once-painful song means to her. In an essay about 'Body Better,' she directly connected the song to insecurity and comparison after a breakup. Afterglow can use her catalogue to link listeners who prefer Sara Kays or Gracie Abrams with more upbeat but emotionally precise storytelling. Her songs should not all be described as strictly autobiographical without individual evidence.
